title: DPWH chief Dizon to testify in graft trial of Zaldy Co, others
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon will testify in the trial of former lawmaker Zaldy Co and his co-accused on graft charges in connection with alleged anomalous…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon will testify in the trial of former lawmaker Zaldy Co and his co-accused on graft charges in connection with alleged anomalous flood control project in Mindoro, the Sandiganbayan said on Wednesday.

Associate Justice Maryann Corpuz-Mañalac made this announcement as the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division heard testimonies from two cashier officers of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in Mimaropa (Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan).
“As agreed upon, let the presentation of the next witness in the person of Secretary Vince Dizon proceed on September 23, at 8:30 in the morning,” Corpuz-Mañalac.
Corpuz-Mañalac also said the next witness’ judicial affidavit has been submitted online to the court.

In November 2025, the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division issued arrest warrants against Co and his co-accused from the DPWH and Sunwest Corporation in connection with a P289.9 million road dike project in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro, which was flagged as substandard and found to have structural deficiencies.
Co was linked to Sunwest Corporation, which was among the top 15 contractors awarded with the most flood control projects worth P100 billion from July 2022 to May 2025. /gsg
